primary.$description: Alias. Brand color: primary buttons, links, selected states. Light themes: brand 600 (emerald 700) with white text; dark themes: brand 400 with brand-950 text. More contrast: brand 800 / brand 300, 7:1+ on `surface` and `primary-subtle`.

primary-hover.$description: Alias. Hover / pressed state of `primary` (one step darker in light themes, lighter in dark). More contrast: brand 900 / brand 200.

primary-subtle.$description: Alias. Brand tint for selected rows and badges (brand 50 light, brand 950 dark).

on-primary.$description: Alias. Text and icons on `primary` fills (white in light themes, brand 950 in dark).

secondary.$description: Alias. Secondary button fill; hover fill for outline and ghost buttons.

highlight.$description: The keyboard-highlighted item in a list: Menu items, Combobox and TimePicker options, the Sidebar's current page. One step stronger than `secondary` in light (about 1.3:1 on `surface`); in dark it shares `secondary`'s zinc-700 (1.7:1 on `surface`, 1.4:1 on `surface-overlay`), so a `primary` bar keeps 3:1 on it in every brand, paired with a 2px `primary` bar at the item's start. Text on it keeps 4.5:1.

pressed.$description: Alias. The fill while a row, tab, day or page button is held down (`:active`): one step past its hover. `text` keeps 7:1+ on it.

surface.$description: Alias. Page and card background (white light, zinc-900 dark).

surface-muted.$description: Alias. Secondary panels, sidebars, table headers.

surface-raised.$description: Alias. A raised card (Card `elevated`). One step up from `surface` in dark, where a shadow doesn't show.

surface-overlay.$description: Alias. Anything in the top layer: Menu, Popover, Dialog, Drawer, Toast and the Combobox, DatePicker and TimePicker lists.

field.$description: Alias. Background of text inputs, selects and other form fields.

field-readonly.$description: Alias. Background of a read-only or disabled form field: a step flatter than `field` (zinc-50 in light, the page's zinc-900 in dark), so it reads as not editable while its `field-border` still outlines it.

field-border.$description: Alias. Border of form fields. 3:1+ against `field` and `surface` in every theme, as WCAG 1.4.11 requires for a control's boundary.

placeholder.$description: Alias. Placeholder text in form fields (4.5:1+ on `field`). Placeholders are hints, never labels.

overlay.$description: Alias. The dimmed backdrop behind dialogs and drawers (zinc-900 at 50% in light themes, zinc-950 at 70% in dark).

surface-inverse.$description: Alias. Contrasting blocks: tooltips, inverse banners.

text.$description: Alias. Body text and headings on `surface`.

text-muted.$description: Alias. Secondary text, captions, placeholders (4.5:1+ on `surface` in every theme).

border-strong.$description: Alias. Emphasised dividers and outlines. Form fields use `field-border`, which meets the 3:1 a control boundary needs.

border-raised.$description: Alias. A raised card's edge: invisible in light (white on white), a 1px lighter edge in dark.

border-overlay.$description: Alias. The edge of a top-layer surface. In dark it is one step stronger than `border`, so a menu stands off the page.

focus-ring.$description: Alias. Keyboard focus outline, in the brand hue (3:1+ on `surface` in every theme). More contrast: brand 700 / brand 300.

success.$description: Alias. Success icons and fills (3:1). For success text use `success-text`.

success-text.$description: Alias. Success text on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `success-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

warning.$description: Alias. Warning icons and fills; put dark text on it. For warning text use `warning-text`.

warning-text.$description: Alias. Warning text on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `warning-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

danger.$description: Alias. Errors, destructive buttons; white text on it (4.8:1). For error text on dark surfaces use `red-400`.

on-danger.$description: Alias. Text and icons on `danger` fills.

danger-text.$description: Alias. Destructive text and icons on `surface`, `danger-subtle` and its hover (5.3:1+ in every theme).

danger-subtle-hover.$description: Alias. Hover fill for destructive secondary, outline and ghost buttons.

danger-border.$description: Alias. Border of a destructive outline button.

info-text.$description: Alias. Info text on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `info-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

link-visited.$description: Alias. A visited link in reading content (Prose): a shade apart from primary, 4.5:1+ on `surface` and `surface-muted` in every theme.

chart-1.$description: Alias. Chart series 1 (blue): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbours alternate darker and lighter, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-2.$description: Alias. Chart series 2 (orange): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbours alternate darker and lighter, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-3.$description: Alias. Chart series 3 (teal): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbours alternate darker and lighter, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-4.$description: Alias. Chart series 4 (pink): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbours alternate darker and lighter, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-5.$description: Alias. Chart series 5 (violet): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbours alternate darker and lighter, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-6.$description: Alias. Chart series 6 (amber): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbours alternate darker and lighter, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-7.$description: Alias. Chart series 7 (emerald): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbours alternate darker and lighter, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-8.$description: Alias. Chart series 8 (red): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbours alternate darker and lighter, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-seq-1.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 1 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before.

chart-seq-2.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 2 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before.

chart-seq-3.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 3 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before.

chart-seq-4.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 4 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before.

chart-seq-5.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 5 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before, and the last is 3:1+.

chart-div-1.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 1 of 7 (below the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle; the ends are 3:1+.

chart-div-2.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 2 of 7 (below the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-3.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 3 of 7 (below the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-4.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 4 of 7 (the middle, no change): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-5.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 5 of 7 (above the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-6.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 6 of 7 (above the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-7.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 7 of 7 (above the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle; the ends are 3:1+.

chart-grid.$description: Alias. Chart grid lines: quiet, behind the data.

chart-axis.$description: Alias. Chart axis lines and ticks (3:1+ on `surface` in every theme).

chart-label.$description: Alias. Chart axis labels, values and legend text (4.5:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme).

chart-gap.$description: Alias. The gap drawn between neighbouring bars, slices and areas, so each one has 3:1+ against what touches it (WCAG 1.4.11). The page color: set it to the card's on a raised surface.
